key_findings: L09 must model baseline, steady, fault, recovery, and post-recovery windows.
Required metrics include latency percentiles, memory growth/leak summaries, restart delta, error taxonomy, and baseline comparison.
Large profiles must be bounded or resource-aware.
Current tests validate bounded P11 smoke, baseline NO_BASELINE_YET, restart delta, and memory missing semantics.
They do not validate the five-window L09 model or 30/50/100 profiles.
The schema is permissive and does not require L09 windows, source paths, or missing semantics.
Current stability catalog reads P11 only.
It does not catalog stability window trends or 30/50/100 bounded profiles.

findings.description: Current stability smoke artifacts do not encode the required L09 multi-stage model.
evidence: P11 samples include metrics.interval but no baseline, steady, fault, recovery, or post_recovery window label.
P11 report has one summary block, not per-window summaries.

findings.description: Current stability schema is too permissive to prevent skeleton or fabricated L09 reports.
evidence: stability_report.schema.json allows additionalProperties and requires only generic top-level fields.

findings.description: 30/50/100 scale evidence exists, but there is no bounded stability soak profile audit tying those node counts to soak time series and resource preflight.
evidence: P12/P13 have resource preflight and scale/fault artifacts but no stability_soak_profile artifacts.

proposed_harness.name: Strict stability report and timeseries schemas
proposed_harness.acceptance: Schemas require soak_profile, metrics_timeseries_path, baseline_comparison_path, summary.windows for all five windows, latency p50/p95/p99, memory growth/leak status, restart delta, error taxonomy, and explicit missing reasons.

proposed_harness.name: Fake deterministic multi-stage soak timeline tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Fake timeline tests validate ordered JSONL samples, window summaries, percentile ordering, memory growth, restart deltas, and error taxonomy.

proposed_harness.name: Stability soak artifact audit
proposed_harness.acceptance: Audit reads JSON and JSONL artifacts only, emits stability_soak_metrics.json, rejects invented long-run claims, validates P14 boundary, and checks source paths and node counts.

proposed_harness.name: 30/50/100 bounded or resource-aware profile checks
proposed_harness.acceptance: For node counts 30, 50, and 100, audit requires bounded measured profiles with JSONL and resource preflight, or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON profiles tied to resource preflight blockers.

implementation_plan.step: Define strict artifact contracts before implementation.
implementation_plan.rationale: L09 needs schema-first protection against permissive reports that omit windows, missing semantics, or source links.
Fake tests lock down timeline ordering, window summaries, percentile math, memory growth, restart delta, and error taxonomy without requiring Docker.

implementation_plan.step: Add the artifact audit script and CI guard.
implementation_plan.rationale: The audit validates machine-readable artifacts, cross-artifact consistency, bounded profile semantics, and resource-aware skips.

acceptance_criteria: Every stability profile emits JSONL time series validated line-by-line from machine-readable artifacts.
P11 small-real evidence includes real_valkey true, Valkey 9.1.x, observed nodes >= 6, data-path proof, cleanup PASS, and schema validation PASS.
The L09 model includes baseline, steady, fault, recovery, and post_recovery windows in report summary and time series.
30/50/100 profiles are bounded measured profiles or explicit SKIPPED_WITH_REASON profiles tied to resource preflight blockers.
Metric catalog, coverage matrix, provenance graph, and rendered reports trace stability metrics back to JSON/JSONL artifacts.
risks: Running 50/100 real bounded soaks can be resource-expensive.
A short smoke window may be misrepresented as long-run stability.
Fault/recovery windows could be fabricated without safe owned-container fault evidence.
Report builders might accidentally read rendered CSV/HTML as input.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not use P14 or 1000-node real artifacts as L09 evidence.
Do not mark 30/50/100 profiles PASS without resource preflight and either measured JSONL or explicit SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
Do not infer metrics from Markdown, HTML, SVG, or CSV report views.
Do not weaken schemas by making required L09 fields optional to pass old artifacts.
notes: Harness design is approved for main-agent stage design. The core guardrail is a new stability soak artifact audit backed by stricter schemas and deterministic fake timeline tests.
